aboutGame.title: What is zombie arena?
paragraphs: zombie arena is a high-octane wave-based survival shooter where players face relentless hordes of undead monstrosities in barricaded colosseums. Featuring intense PvE horde combat, escalating difficulty rounds, deep weapon customization, and distinct survivor classes, every run demands spatial discipline and strategic resource management.

Whether you are coordinating with a tactical squad in co-op matchmaking, testing your mechanical reflexes on solo Nightmare Mode, or climbing the global leaderboards with optimized weapon builds, our community wiki provides verified data tables, loadout rankings, and tactical walkthroughs for every stage of your run.

modules.name: zombie arena Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module helps new players understand the core gameplay loop, zombie wave survival strategies, weapon usage, and basic progression systems. It targets beginner searches from players looking for how to start and survive longer in Zombie Arena.

highlights.detail: Currency Stacking: Focus precision headshots with starter pistols on Waves 1-3 to maximize early credits.
Threat Assessment: Prioritize fast Sprinters and Leapers immediately before managing slow Shamblers.
Utility Unlocks: Invest credits in reload speed and magazine upgrades before purchasing expensive rifles.
Perimeter Kiting: Maintain wide circular routes around arena edges to avoid corner traps.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about zombie arena.

items.question: What is zombie arena?
items.answer: zombie arena is a fast-paced wave survival combat game where players fight escalating hordes of infected undead, upgrade firearms, unlock specialized character classes, and survive intense colosseum encounters.

items.question: How do I redeem zombie arena codes?
items.answer: To redeem zombie arena codes, launch the game, navigate to the Settings or Rewards menu, tap the Codes button, enter the active code string exactly as shown, and confirm to claim your free credits and booster crates.

items.question: What is the best weapon in zombie arena?
items.answer: The Auto-Combat Shotgun and Heavy Rotary Cannon are top-ranked S-Tier weapons in zombie arena, delivering unmatched close-quarters crowd control and heavy armor piercing against elite waves.

items.question: Which character class should beginners pick in zombie arena?
items.answer: Combat Engineer and Field Medic are recommended for beginners in zombie arena due to their automated turret defenses, self-sustain healing, and generous team utility.

items.question: How does Nightmare Mode work in zombie arena?
items.answer: Nightmare Mode in zombie arena increases base enemy sprint speeds by 1.45x, introduces aggressive mutant variants from early rounds, shortens revive bleedout timers, and reduces supply drop frequency.
